stage: CORE-023 Task A - deterministic offline canonicalization
intent: Deterministic image processing only. No AI redrawing, no foreground crop, no local warp, no inpainting, no redesign.

canvas.alpha: fully opaque; any source alpha is composited over opaque white

fit: uniform_scale_entire_source_canvas_letterbox (inner box = canvas inset by min_margin_px + fit_inset_px)
color_handling: 8-bit sRGB RGB; no ICC conversion; no gamma change; no sharpening
coordinate_domain: edge_coordinates; pixel index i has its center at i+0.5
transform: single affine: uniform scale plus translation; no rotation, no shear, no perspective
